name: Venture Capital Fund for Backward Classes (VCF-BC)
teName: వెనుకబడిన తరగతుల కోసం వెంచర్ క్యాపిటల్ ఫండ్ (VCF-BC)
teBrief: వెనుకబడిన తరగతుల (OBC/BC) వ్యాపారవేత్తలు ప్రమోట్ చేసే వృద్ధి-దశ మరియు వినూత్న సంస్థలకు రాయితీ వెంచర్ క్యాపిటల్ ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందించే సామాజిక న్యాయ మంత్రిత్వ శాఖ కార్యక్రమం.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: Dedicated venture capital financing initiative of the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, managed by IFCI Venture Capital Funds, supporting scalable and innovative enterprises promoted by Backward Class entrepreneurs.
sourceCredit: Source: IFCI Venture / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
briefFull: Dedicated venture capital financing initiative of the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, managed by IFCI Venture Capital Funds, supporting scalable and innovative enterprises promoted by Backward Class entrepreneurs.
details:
The Venture Capital Fund for Backward Classes (VCF-BC) is a dedicated institutional finance initiative sponsored by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India and managed by IFCI Venture Capital Funds Ltd.

It promotes entrepreneurship among Backward Classes by providing concessional venture capital assistance to scalable, commercially viable enterprises promoted by eligible Backward Class entrepreneurs.
benefits:
- Concessional financial assistance structured as equity, optionally convertible debentures or subordinated/term venture debt depending on project requirements.
- Enables Backward Class promoters of growth-stage companies and innovative startups to access long-term risk capital.
eligibility:
1. Companies / enterprises promoted by eligible Backward Class (OBC) entrepreneurs holding majority shareholding as stipulated by fund guidelines.
2. Project must demonstrate commercial viability, innovation or scalable growth potential.
3. Confirm current shareholding, ticket-size, sector and eligibility norms directly on the IFCI Venture website before submitting an application.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official IFCI Venture Capital Funds website (ifciventure.com) and review current VCF-BC investment guidelines and eligibility norms.
2. Prepare an investment-ready project report, corporate filings and valid OBC/BC promoter certification.
3. Submit the application directly through IFCI Venture's official submission channel.
documentsRequired:
- Valid OBC / Backward Class Certificate of eligible promoter(s)
- Company incorporation records (Certificate of Incorporation, MoA/AoA, shareholding pattern)
- Detailed Project Report (DPR) / Business Plan and audited financials (where applicable)
- KYC documents of promoters and directors

faqs.a: The fund is sponsored by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment and managed by IFCI Venture Capital Funds Ltd. Confirm active guidelines on ifciventure.com.
